# Theme gallery

Every theme below is real: each preview is painted with that theme's own colour
tokens and fonts, read from the published package. Click one to open it as a
complete, browsable storefront in the demo.

Use the id with `defaultTheme`:

```tsx
<CatalogApp defaultTheme="coffee" />
```

<ThemeGallery />

## Reading the labels

The two words under each preview are its `heroStyle` and `cardStyle` — the home
page hero treatment and the product card treatment. Filter by either to find
themes that share a layout, which is useful when you want a specific structure
but a different palette.

Both are settable independently when you build your own theme. See
[Themes](../guides/themes.md) for the full token list, and
[Build a client brand theme](../recipes/brand-theme.md) for a worked example.
